sets.name: Franchise agreement
sets.engagement: Due diligence review of a franchise acquisition opportunity involving Airsopure International Group, Inc.'s franchise system.

items.name: Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD)
items.what_it_is: Pre‑sale disclosure document required by the FTC containing franchisor background, fees, obligations.
items.why_needed: To verify the franchisor’s disclosures match the franchise agreement and assess offering terms.

items.name: Audited financial statements of the franchisor
items.what_it_is: Independent audit of balance sheet, income statement, cash flows for past three fiscal years.
items.why_needed: To evaluate franchisor’s financial stability and ability to support franchise network.

items.name: Franchisee historical financial performance (if existing)
items.what_it_is: Historical profit‑and‑loss, balance sheet, and cash‑flow data for existing franchise units.
items.why_needed: To gauge unit economics and potential return on investment for a new franchise.

items.name: Tax returns (last three years) of the franchisor
items.what_it_is: Federal and state corporate tax returns filed by the franchisor for the prior three years.
items.why_needed: To confirm reported income, identify tax liabilities, and assess tax risk.

items.name: Operations Manual
items.what_it_is: Confidential guide detailing standards, procedures, and training for franchise operations.
items.why_needed: To ensure the franchisee can meet brand standards and understand operational obligations.
items.note: A section with a similar heading exists in AIRTECHINTERNATIONALGROUPINC_05_08_2000-EX-10.4-FRANCHISE AGREEMENT.txt: "8.  OPERATIONS MANUAL". Check whether it is what is needed.

items.name: Insurance certificates (general liability, property, workers’ compensation)
items.what_it_is: Current certificates of insurance showing coverage limits and effective dates.
items.why_needed: To verify adequate risk coverage required by the franchise agreement and protect assets.

items.name: Intellectual property registration details (trademarks, logos)
items.what_it_is: USPTO trademark registrations and common‑law rights for the AIRSOPURE brand and associated logos.
items.why_needed: To confirm the franchisor owns enforceable marks licensed to franchisees.

items.name: Real estate lease agreements for typical franchise locations
items.what_it_is: Sample lease agreements illustrating rent, term, renewal, and improvement obligations for franchise sites.
items.why_needed: To estimate occupancy costs and assess site‑selection constraints for new franchises.

sets.name: Annual report (10-K)
sets.engagement: Due diligence review of United Parcel Service, Inc. based on its 2020 Form 10‑K filing.

items.name: Federal, state and foreign tax returns (including schedules) for the last three years
items.what_it_is: Complete tax returns with supporting schedules showing income, deductions, credits and tax positions.
items.why_needed: Note 15 discloses income tax expense but does not provide the underlying returns needed to assess tax risks.

items.name: Capital expenditure budget and project list for FY 2021‑2023
items.what_it_is: Planned capex amounts, major projects and timing for property, plant and equipment additions.
items.why_needed: Note 5 details historical PP&E but does not reveal future spending plans essential for valuation.

items.name: Material customer contracts (top 10 by revenue)
items.what_it_is: Copies or summaries of the largest customer agreements, including term, volume commitments and pricing.
items.why_needed: Note 2 addresses revenue recognition and contract assets/liabilities but does not show the actual contracts driving revenue.

items.name: Litigation detail: settlement amounts, reserves and insurance recoveries for each pending case
items.what_it_is: Case‑by‑case description of disclosed legal proceedings, including accrued liabilities and any insurance recoveries.
items.why_needed: Item 3 lists legal proceedings but lacks the quantitative reserves and settlement specifics needed to evaluate exposure.

items.name: Intellectual property portfolio schedule (patents, trademarks, trade secrets)
items.what_it_is: Listing of owned and licensed IP assets with registration numbers, jurisdictions, remaining life and licensing terms.
items.why_needed: Note 8 covers goodwill and intangible assets but does not itemize the IP base that supports competitive advantage.

items.name: ESG environmental data: emissions, waste, water usage and sustainability initiatives
items.what_it_is: Metrics on greenhouse‑gas emissions, waste management, water consumption and related sustainability programs.
items.why_needed: The 10‑K headings contain no ESG‑environmental section, yet such data are required to assess climate‑related risks.

items.name: Related‑party transaction disclosures (amounts, terms, business purpose)
items.what_it_is: Detail of all transactions with affiliates, officers, directors or significant shareholders.
items.why_needed: While Note 12 discusses shareholders’ equity, it does not enumerate related‑party deals that could affect financial integrity.

items.name: Internal audit reports and SOX 404 control testing results
items.what_it_is: Reports from the internal audit function detailing control deficiencies, remediation status and testing outcomes.
items.why_needed: Item 9A mentions controls and procedures but does not provide the underlying audit evidence needed to assess control reliability.

items.name: IT security assessment: penetration test reports, vulnerability scans and incident response logs
items.what_it_is: Results of external penetration testing, vulnerability assessments and records of any security incidents.
items.why_needed: No heading or note addresses IT security; such information is vital to evaluate cyber risk in a logistics‑heavy business.

items.name: Insurance policy schedule (coverages, limits, deductibles and claims history)
items.what_it_is: Listing of all major insurance policies (property, casualty, directors‑and‑officers, cargo, etc.) with key terms.
items.why_needed: The filing does not disclose insurance arrangements, which are necessary to gauge potential loss exposures and recovery ability.
